name: Chole Bhature
instructions: 1. Soak and boil chickpeas with tea bags. 2. Sauté onions, ginger, and spices. 3. Add chickpeas and simmer until dark and spicy. 4. Make a soft dough for bhatura, ferment, and deep fry until puffed.
description: The golden puff of indulgence, served with the spicy soul of Punjab.
